skill.name: socialdatax-sensitive-check
skill.description: Check draft text for sensitive terms and publication risks through SocialDataX, with platform context and suggested revisions.
skill.summary: Review text for Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Kuaishou, or general use through the SocialDataX CLI or an available MCP tool.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One execution finding is confirmed because the documented command automatically fetches and runs an unpinned npm package. The other 27 alerts concern Markdown, ordinary URLs, expected authentication references, or readable Chinese text; no prompt injection or encoded payload was found. Additional risks involve server-side text retention without an explicit consent step and draft exposure through command-line arguments.

remediation.issue: The recommended command automatically executes the mutable socialdatax-skills@latest package.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify its provenance, and obtain approval before package installation or execution.

remediation.issue: The workflow submits text to a service that retains drafts and results, without an explicit consent checkpoint.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose remote storage before submission, request approval, minimize sensitive text, and document retention and deletion controls.

remediation.issue: The CLI example places draft text in process arguments despite an assurance that the argument section does not echo it.
remediation.suggestion: Use a supported stdin input mode or the available MCP tool; otherwise warn about argument exposure and avoid confidential drafts.

content.user_title: Check Social Media Drafts for Sensitive Terms
content.value_statement: Social media drafts can contain sensitive terms and platform-specific publication risks. This skill guides SocialDataX text checks and presents available risk signals with revision suggestions.
actual_capabilities: Guide text checks through the SocialDataX CLI using a supplied draft.
Select generic, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, or Kuaishou platform context.
Use check_sensitive_text when its MCP tool is already available.
Summarize available violation indicators, risk levels, categories, highlights, and revision suggestions.
Avoid repeating the complete draft unless the user explicitly requests it.
Distinguish dependency failures, API errors, and insufficient-balance responses.
limitations: Only text checks are documented; image checks are not supported.
Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
Submitted text and results are stored remotely; the CLI example also exposes text through process arguments.
The external CLI and service implementation are not included; results do not guarantee platform approval or legal compliance.

use_cases.title: Review a Xiaohongshu caption
use_cases.description: Check a nonconfidential caption for reported sensitive terms and consider suggested revisions before publishing.

use_cases.title: Screen promotional copy
use_cases.description: Review a Douyin promotional draft and summarize reported risk categories for an editor.

use_cases.title: Prepare an internal review note
use_cases.description: Check approved, redacted text using generic context and separate service findings from unresolved compliance questions.

prompt_templates.title: Check a short draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this nonconfidential text using generic context: [draft]. Before submission, explain remote retention and ask for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Review platform-specific copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [draft] for Xiaohongshu. Confirm submission approval, then report available risk indicators and suggestions without repeating the complete draft.

prompt_templates.title: Compare a revised draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [original] and [revision] for Douyin after submission approval. Compare reported risks and identify remaining concerns without promising publication approval.

prompt_templates.title: Run a controlled review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [redacted draft] for Kuaishou after retention approval. Use an available MCP tool or an approved, pinned CLI; distinguish returned fields from interpretation.

output_examples.input: Check a generic draft before submitting it to the service.
output: Submission paused: SocialDataX stores submitted text and detection results.
Please approve remote submission after removing confidential information.

output_examples.input: Illustrative review: the service flags an absolute promotional claim in an approved Xiaohongshu draft.
output: Reported concern: an absolute promotional claim was flagged.
Revision suggestion: replace the absolute claim with a specific, supportable statement.
Publication approval is not guaranteed. These example findings are illustrative, not a live service result.

output_examples.input: The service returns an insufficient-balance error.
output: The check did not complete because the service balance is insufficient.
Do not repeat the request until the balance issue is resolved.

best_practices: Remove confidential details and approve remote retention before submitting a draft.
Use an available MCP tool or an approved, pinned CLI version; keep API keys out of prompts and logs.
Choose the intended platform and review suggestions manually before publication.
anti_patterns: Submitting private customer data or unreleased material without authorization.
Running mutable package versions automatically with confidential text in command-line arguments.
Treating a low-risk result as guaranteed platform acceptance or legal approval.

faq.question: Which platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The documented contexts are generic, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, and Kuaishou.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A SocialDataX API key must be configured through SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY. Do not paste the key into prompts.

faq.question: Does the check stay on my machine?
faq.answer: No. SocialDataX processes the text remotely and stores submitted text and structured results for history, billing, and troubleshooting.

faq.question: Can this skill check images?
faq.answer: No. The documented version supports text checks only.

faq.question: Does it publish or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts. Read-only behavior does not eliminate remote data retention.

faq.question: Does a successful check guarantee compliance?
faq.answer: No. Results depend on the external service and available fields. Human review remains necessary for platform policies and legal obligations.
